title: Change of rings of a universally tensor-acyclic complex
statement: Let O → O' be a morphism φ of commutative ring sheaves on a site with the sheafification hypotheses of lem-pur-change-of-rings-acyclic-kflat. Let E be an additive functor whose objects and maps are changeOfRings φ and changeOfRingsHom φ via equalities h and hm with equality transports. Let K be a cochain complex of O-modules such that Tot(F ⊗_O K) is acyclic for every cochain complex F of O-modules. Then termwise E(K) is acyclic as a complex of O'-modules. No K-flatness or acyclicity hypothesis on K is part of this comparison theorem.

proof.text: Put U=restriction along phi and S=U(Oprime). Apply hT to the single complex S[0]. The proved upstream CochainComplex.mapBifunctorSingle₁Iso (WeilConjectures.FromJoel.Algebra.Homology.BifunctorSingle) identifies its total tensor with termwise S tensor K, so that complex is acyclic.

Use the natural module comparison e_M from lem-pur-change-of-rings-tensor-comparison. For each degree i, compose U.mapIso(eqToIso(h(K^i))) with e_(K^i). The map formula hm, functoriality of U, cancellation of opposite equality transports and naturality of e show these form an isomorphism from U(E(K)) to the termwise tensor complex. Transfer exactness in every degree along this chain isomorphism.

Restriction of scalars leaves the underlying abelian sheaf and its differential unchanged. The forgetful toSheaf functor is faithful and exact: finite limits are supplied by Mathlib and finite colimits by the proved source instances in WeilConjectures.Mathlib.Algebra.Category.ModuleCat.Presheaf.Sheafification. For each short complex L.sc(i), ShortComplex.exact_map_iff_of_faithful reflects exactness from abelian sheaves. Apply toSheaf to the exact restricted short complex; it is definitionally the underlying abelian short complex of L.sc(i). This proves E(K) acyclic without any extra hypothesis.

lean.statement: theorem changeOfRings_acyclic_of_tensor_acyclic {C : Type u} [Category.{u} C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C} [J.HasSheafCompose (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})] [J.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{u}] [HasWeakSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{u}] {O O' : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u}} (φ : O ⟶ O') (E : SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 O) ⥤ SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 O')) (h : ∀ M : SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 O), E.obj M = changeOfRings.{u, u, u} φ M) (hm : ∀ {M N : SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 O)} (a : M ⟶ N), E.map a = eqToHom (h M) ≫ changeOfRingsHom.{u, u, u} φ M a ≫ eqToHom (h N).symm) [E.Additive] (K : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 O)) ℤ) (hT : ∀ F : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 O)) ℤ, letI := monoidalCategory O (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor F K (curriedTensor _)).Acyclic) : ((E.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K).Acyclic
